name: The King's Achievement
desc: Benson's novel of 1905 on the dissolution of the monasteries under Henry VIII: the brothers Ralph and Anthony Torridon, one drawn to Cromwell's service, the other to the cloister, caught in the fall of the English religious houses.
desc_pt: O romance de Benson (1905) sobre a dissolução dos mosteiros sob Henrique VIII: os irmãos Ralph e Anthony Torridon, um atraído ao serviço de Cromwell, o outro ao claustro, apanhados na queda das casas religiosas inglesas.
edition: The King's Achievement (London: Hutchinson, 1905), Project Gutenberg #16375, proofread.
srcnote: Parts and chapters as printed; the numbered sections inside chapters are kept as ## headings.
